Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager

Class FileOperations

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.filemanager.FileOperations
public final class FileOperations extends Object
Filesystem operations for the file manager, built on java.nio.file and the shared Opener (for trash / xdg-open).

Every operation reports success/failure rather than throwing, so the UI can show a message. Copy and move recurse into directories and report byte progress through an optional callback (driven from a SwingWorker).
